_about: Every definition the site shows (scripts/definitions.py). Edited in the admin’s Definitions tab; only status "live" text reaches the site.

direction.Fade: Fade means bet the other side.

last_time_format.side: Last time: {date}, {team} was {price} vs {opp}. {winner} won the {segment} {score}.
last_time_format.note: {result} is the plain outcome of the bet, e.g. 'Over 1.5', 'both teams scored', 'tied'. Never a ✓ or ✗.

record_line.tooltip: Record betting this trend this season, how often it won, how often the same bet won across all games, and profit at 1 unit per bet.

streaks.section: Teams on a run of 3 or more straight in the opening segment, counted from their most recent game. A tie or push ends a streak.
streaks.colors: Win and loss streaks run green to red. Over/Under and Yes/No streaks get darker the longer they run.

label:fireworks.name: 🎆 Fireworks
label:fireworks.short: Both teams’ {segment}s usually go Over. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:fireworks_btts.name: 🎆 Fireworks (BTTS)
label:fireworks_btts.short: In both teams’ {segment}s, both teams usually score. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:lockdown.name: 🔒 Lockdown
label:lockdown.short: Both teams’ {segment}s usually go Under. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:lockdown_btts.name: 🔒 Lockdown (BTTS)
label:lockdown_btts.short: In both teams’ {segment}s, usually not both teams score. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

label:mismatch.name: 🥊 Mismatch

label:tug_of_war.name: 🪢 Tug of war

label:tug_of_war_btts.name: 🪢 Tug of war (BTTS)
label:tug_of_war_btts.short: In one team’s {segment}s both teams usually score; in the other’s, usually not both teams score.

term:3-way-moneyline.name: 3-Way Moneyline
term:3-way-moneyline.short: Home, away or tie, each its own bet. A tie loses both team bets; the tie bet pays only on a tie.

term:btts.name: Both Teams to Score (BTTS)
term:btts.short: Yes wins if both teams score in the segment; No wins if at least one team is held scoreless.

term:first-five.name: First Five (F5)
term:first-five.short: A baseball bet settled after five innings, before most bullpens enter.

term:league-average.name: League average
term:league-average.short: How often the same bet won across the whole league this season, for comparison with a trend or a team.

term:moneyline.name: Moneyline
term:moneyline.short: A bet on which team wins. In a segment bet, the team leading when the segment ends; a tie in a 2-way segment moneyline is a push.

term:nrfi.name: NRFI
term:nrfi.short: No Run First Inning: wins if neither team scores in the 1st inning.

term:push.name: Push
term:push.short: A tie with the line: the bet is refunded. It counts as neither a win nor a loss.

term:run-line.name: Run line
term:run-line.short: Baseball’s spread, usually 0.5 runs in the first five. The favorite must lead; the underdog covers by leading or tying.

term:segment.name: First period / quarter / half
term:segment.short: The opening part of a game RTYB tracks: 1st period (NHL), 1st quarter and 1st half (basketball, football), 1st inning and first five (MLB).

term:small-sample.name: Small sample
term:small-sample.short: Fewer than 5 games. RTYB hides records this small because a few results can swing the percentage a lot.

term:spread.name: Spread
term:spread.short: A head start in points. The favorite must win by more than the spread to cover; the underdog covers by losing by less or winning.

term:total.name: Total (Over/Under)
term:total.short: A bet on the combined score. Over wins above the posted number, Under below it; landing exactly on a whole number is a push.

term:units.name: Units
term:units.short: 1 unit = $100 at the listed price. +2.06u means $206 profit betting $100 on every game; a loss is -1 unit, a push 0.

term:yrfi.name: YRFI
term:yrfi.short: Yes Run First Inning: wins if either team scores in the 1st inning.
